user.title: Add Lockable Cover
user.description: This adds Lockable Cover once. You then add a proxy for each cover you want to protect, from the integration page.

user.title: Add a lockable cover
user.description: Create a proxy that refuses to open while the chosen lock is engaged. Closing and stopping are always allowed.
